title: 同花顺 concept-board scrape receipt v1
description: One receipt per FULL-taxonomy THS concept-board scrape attempt, written by scripts/scrape_ths_weekly.py to data/baskets_china_ths/receipts/scrape_<date>.json. Formalises the complete-or-fail law (GMI masterplan G0.4) at the RUN level: `complete` is true only when every attempted concept was fully paged, and only a complete attempt promotes a raw side-car into data/baskets_china_ths/snapshots/. An attempt that resolves nothing still leaves a receipt — the whole point is that a scrape which never ran and a scrape which ran and found no change must not look the same on disk.

date.description: The as-of date of the attempt; also the dated side-car stem when complete.

concepts_attempted.description: Concept boards in the taxonomy this attempt tried to resolve.

concepts_fetched.description: Concept boards fully paged (COMPLETE member lists only — a truncated board is never counted, never recorded).

members_total.description: Member slots across every fetched board (a name in four boards counts four times).

complete.description: True only when concepts_fetched == concepts_attempted and truncated is empty. The gate for promoting the raw side-car.

truncated.description: Concept-board names left unresolved (throttled, truncated mid-pagination, retired, or never reached inside the run budget). Empty exactly when complete is true.

writer.description: Module that produced this receipt, e.g. scripts.scrape_ths_weekly.

passes.description: Resumable cool-down passes spent this attempt (THS IP-throttles bursts, so one pass rarely resolves the whole taxonomy).

budget_minutes.description: Wall-clock budget the attempt was given, so a false `complete` caused by an exhausted budget is distinguishable from one caused by a hard throttle.

budget_exhausted.description: True when the attempt stopped because it ran out of budget rather than because it ran out of unresolved concepts.

promoted.description: Whether a raw side-car was promoted into snapshots/ by this attempt. Must be false whenever complete is false.

pit_rows_added.description: Rows the promoted side-car added to data/baskets_china_ths/membership_history.parquet (0 when the lane gate refused, which a hand-run always does).
